description: Send a consultation request to the firm on the person's behalf; the firm replies by email. Confirm name, email and message with the person and get their agreement to the privacy policy first. Call once with dry_run: true to check, then without it to send. Limited to 3 per hour per client.

agent.description: Name of the AI assistant submitting on the person's behalf.

consent_privacy.description: true only after the person agreed to https://sw-cpas.co.kr/privacy/.

dry_run.description: true validates and returns what would be sent, without storing or sending.

email.description: Email address the firm should reply to.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key; retries with the same key are not submitted twice.

message.description: What the person needs help with (at least 10 characters).

name.description: Full name of the person asking. Ask them; never invent it.

phone.description: Phone number, if the person wants a call.

topic.description: Short topic, e.g. 미국 법인 설립.

name: request_consultation
title: 상담 신청
